fusions.name: Bog Landing
fusions.desc: You come down hard on all four feet, dealing 30 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles as a critical hit and leaving each [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Spring From Still
fusions.desc: A springing kick at a target up to 6 tiles away, dealing 8 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full range. Holds 3 charges; kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Sudden Bound
fusions.desc: Springs you 5 tiles forward, and you move 15% faster for 3 seconds after.

fusions.name: Snap From the Reeds
fusions.desc: When you have gone a while without a critical hit, your next strike gains 20% critical hit chance. Once every 10 seconds.
